springBootCompatibility.interface: HTTP REST /internal/ai endpoints with standard JSON payloads
springBootCompatibility.dataTypes: UUIDv4, ISO-8601 UTC timestamps, normalized bounding boxes [0.0, 1.0]

persistencePostgresCompatibility.entityMapping: Finding DTO maps directly to PostgreSQL findings table and PostGIS spatial geometry
persistencePostgresCompatibility.idempotency: Deterministic finding IDs and job execution run IDs prevent duplicate row creation

redisAsyncJobCompatibility.jobQueue: Redis-backed asynchronous job broker with exponential retry backoff and dead-letter queue
redisAsyncJobCompatibility.statusPolling: GET /internal/ai/jobs/{job_id} supports polling or webhook notification

minioS3StorageCompatibility.evidenceFetching: Per-evidence fault-isolated streaming from MinIO/S3 compatible object store
minioS3StorageCompatibility.limits: Enforces 20MB image size limit and dimension safety boundaries

humanReviewAndSafetyBoundary.zeroDetectionsSemantics: Zero detections indicates lack of visual cue, NEVER an approved inspection.

securityAndTenantIsolation.credentials: All credentials driven by environment variables; zero hardcoded secrets
securityAndTenantIsolation.tenantIsolation: Tenant ID and inspection ID headers strictly scoped on all endpoints
